subject: Next steps: procurement path & payment method for Hippo Analytics
messages:
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>
To: Sophie Lambert <sophie.lambert@hippoanalytics.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sun, 25 Oct 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Next steps: procurement path & payment method for Hippo Analytics

Hi Sophie —

Thanks again for the call this morning — good to hear more about Hippo's planned proof-of-concept for realtime topic extraction. Quick recap and a few qualification questions so we can map the right commercial path: 

- Technical fit: you confirmed Hosted API for the pilot (low-latency, <150ms typical target) and potential Dedicated if throughput ramps.
- Procurement: you mentioned AP has a vendor onboarding process and that payment method may be a gating factor (PO vs corporate card). Can you confirm the preferred path?
- Marketplace interest: you asked whether Redwood is available on cloud marketplaces — yes (AWS listing) and that can simplify purchase if you prefer subscription via marketplace.

Could you confirm:
1) Do you need a purchase order (PO) or can a corporate card be used for the initial pilot? If PO, is there an expected PO date / approval owner?
2) Who is the procurement/AP contact (name + email) so we can send the vendor packet and W-9?
3) Any vendor registration docs we should attach proactively (SOC2, customer questionnaires)?

I'll attach a short vendor packet and a draft SOW for the pilot so your AP and legal can review. If PO is preferred we can route pricing and terms through Sales Ops; if card, we can do immediate provisioning.

Proposed next steps:
- I send vendor packet + draft SOW (today)
- You share AP contact & preferred payment method (by end of week)
- Align on invoice cadence (monthly net30 vs upfront)

Best,
Karthik
Account Executive
Redwood Inference

Attachments: vendor_packet_redwood.pdf, SOW-Hippo-analytics-v1.docx

From: Sophie Lambert <sophie.lambert@hippoanalytics.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Marcus Reid <marcus.reid@hippoanalytics.com>
Date: Sun, 25 Oct 2026 11:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Next steps: procurement path & payment method for Hippo Analytics

Thanks Karthik — appreciate the clear notes. A few answers from AP and finance: 

- Payment method: Hippo prefers to use PO for vendors that will be > $5k/month or those requiring enterprise terms. For a short pilot under ~$5k/month we can use the corporate card. Our pilot is expected to start small but could exceed that if we expand quickly.
- Vendor onboarding: AP will need a W-9, our vendor form filled out, and a SOC2 report before we finalize vendor status.
- Procurement contact: please send vendor docs to Dana Morris (dana.morris@hippoanalytics.com), she owns vendor setup and invoices.

We'll also check with legal about any specific contract redlines but don't expect anything unusual for a pilot. I attached our vendor_requirements checklist for reference.

If you can send the W-9 and SOC2 upfront that will speed the process. And yes — marketplace subscription would be interesting if it avoids a full vendor onboarding.

— Sophie
Head of Data Platform, Hippo Analytics

Attachments: hippo_vendor_requirements.pdf

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>
To: Sophie Lambert <sophie.lambert@hippoanalytics.com>, Dana Morris <dana.morris@hippoanalytics.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sun, 25 Oct 2026 13:27:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Next steps: procurement path & payment method for Hippo Analytics

Great — thanks for the clarity, Sophie. Looping in Dana to kick off vendor onboarding.

I've attached the Redwood vendor packet (vendor_packet_redwood.pdf) which includes our standard W-9 and bank remittance info, plus the SOC2 report (SOC2-report-redwood-2025.pdf). Also attaching the draft SOW we discussed (SOW-Hippo-analytics-v1.docx).

A couple of notes on the procurement paths so you have both options documented: 
- PO route: we can accept PO-based billing, monthly invoices, Net30 payment terms. Sales Ops will need the PO number and remit address. Vendor onboarding typically takes 5–10 business days once AP has the forms.
- Card route: if you prefer to start immediately with the card and stay below the AP threshold, we can provision API keys and begin the pilot the same day — no vendor onboarding needed for the trial spend.
- Marketplace: subscribing via the AWS marketplace will treat Redwood as a marketplace vendor with subscription billing; that often removes vendor onboarding but may affect invoicing (marketplace invoices) and discounting.

Next steps I propose: 
1) I’ll send the vendor packet + SOC2 + W-9 to Dana (attached).
2) Dana, can you confirm receipt and expected onboarding timeline?
3) Sophie/Marcus: if card is acceptable for an initial low-volume pilot, let me know and we can provision immediately; if you prefer PO, we’ll await the PO number and invoice cadence.

Link to AWS marketplace listing (for procurement folks): https://marketplace.aws.amazon.com/listing/redwood-inference

Thanks —
Karthik

Attachments: vendor_packet_redwood.pdf, SOC2-report-redwood-2025.pdf, SOW-Hippo-analytics-v1.docx

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sun, 25 Oct 2026 15:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Next steps: procurement path & payment method for Hippo Analytics

Looping in a quick commercial note —

If Hippo wants to go marketplace, we can offer a standard subscription flow that typically avoids our customers' vendor onboarding (they pay via their cloud marketplace account). Marketplace subscriptions also make billing and renewals simpler. However, final pricing/discounting is influenced by the channel: purchases off-contract through marketplace may not be eligible for enterprise discounts tied to a Reserved or Dedicated commitment.

If they go PO, Sales Ops will need the PO number and the final SOW attached to the invoice. For deal tracking please use deal id HIP-2026-042.

I’m okay with a small first-month promo (10% off) if they commit to a 3-month pilot and sign the SOW — that could nudge them to pick PO route with a short-term commitment. Karthik — if you want me to surface the promo to Sophie, I can.

— Marissa
Senior Sales Manager

From: Dana Morris <dana.morris@hippoanalytics.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>, Sophie Lambert <sophie.lambert@hippoanalytics.com>
Date: Mon, 26 Oct 2026 08:46:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Next steps: procurement path & payment method for Hippo Analytics

Thanks Karthik — received the packet. I’ll run this through our vendor setup this week. Estimated turnaround: 7–10 business days provided there are no open questions from finance. A couple of specifics we’ll need from Redwood: 
- Completed vendor registration form (I see W-9 in the packet but please confirm the vendor name and tax ID match the W-9).
- Invoice remit address and PO contact for the invoice header.
- Preferred invoice cadence (monthly preferred) and payment terms (Net30 OK).

I attached our PO-template for reference; once legal signs off on the SOW we’ll issue a PO against HIP-2026-042. If you’re able to supply an initial invoice for the first month (pro forma) we can attach it to the PO to speed payment once the PO is approved.

— Dana
Senior Accounts Payable Analyst, Hippo Analytics

Attachments: PO-template.pdf

Thanks — looking forward to getting this into AP.

Karthik
